voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Warrnambool, Australia. Eighteen thirty-six. The story goes that stranded whalers, walking home along the coast, saw an old wreck high in the dunes.
Its timber, they said, was dark like mahogany, very hard, and unlike any wood they knew.
Over thirty accounts followed, into the eighteen-eighties. Then, it is said, the drifting sand covered it.
In nineteen ninety-two, Victoria offered a quarter of a million dollars to whoever found it. The reward was withdrawn, unclaimed.
Some say it was a Portuguese caravel. Others doubt it ever existed. It has never been found.
